theorems.name: Submission.dimred_cs_mi_withDensity_dilate
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → (∀ x : Euclid P, f (lam • x) = f x) → ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)).withDensity f ((fun x => lam • x) '' A) = ENNReal.ofReal (lam ^ n) * (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)).withDensity f A
